about: Rahu in each of the twelve bhavas. Rahu has no body of its own, so these readings are weaker than the seven grahas and should be read together with its dispositor and co-tenants. Confidence is set lower across the board for that reason.

rules.says: The self is a project: ambitious, unconventional, and more concerned with becoming something than with being settled.
A real hunger for money and an unorthodox way of speaking; what is eaten and what is said both tend to excess.
A strong placement: nerve, publicity and the willingness to try what others will not.
Home never quite settles; residence far from the birthplace, and property acquired by unusual routes.
Creativity becomes obsession; matters of children take an irregular course and speculation is tempting and costly.
One of the best houses for Rahu: competition is dominated, litigation is won, and opposition is simply absorbed.
Partnership arrives from outside the expected circle, often foreign or across a difference that others remark on.
Pulled towards the occult, the chronic and the sudden; research suits it, and so does keeping other people secrets.
Inherited belief is questioned and often replaced by something foreign; relations with the father or the teacher are irregular.
Ambition is visible and the career takes an unconventional or foreign route; rises can be steep and are not always steady.
The best house for Rahu: large gains, a wide and useful network, and desires that actually get met.
Life abroad, or a life kept partly out of view; expenditure is hard to trace and the inner search can turn obsessive.
